pages.title: Other Pauses
pages.text: If a job stalls without saying Not Printable, check the status line:$(br)$(li)$(l)No Power$(): feed it more RF$(li)$(l)No Filament$(): dock a fuller / higher-tier spool$(li)$(l)Output Full$(): clear the bottom output$(li)$(l)Spool Missing or Full$() (deconstruct): give it room at that tier, in a docked spool or a rack on the cable$(li)$(l)Obstructed$(): clear the build area (the printer never overwrites blocks)$(br2)Every pause is recoverable: fix the cause and the job resumes where it left off.
